# at narrative position

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:atNarrativePosition`](gmeow-atNarrativePosition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/atNarrativePosition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

Anchors a thing — a content segment, a diegetic event, an arc sample, a motif occurrence — to a narrative position. Domain-free: the narration seam, arc samples, and motif occurrences all reuse this one anchor. NOT functional, and deliberately so: the same diegetic event carries coexisting positions in a discourse frame and a story frame, and their disagreement is the flashback made queryable rather than a contradiction ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
